content: For individuals who are managing their diabetes with multiple daily injections (MDI) or continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII), the use of real-time continuous glucose monitoring (rtCGM) devices is strongly recommended. Ideally, these devices should be utilized on a daily basis to ensure optimal consistency in data collection. Frequent and consistent use of rtCGM devices enables more precise adjustments to blood glucose levels, thereby enhancing the overall effectiveness of diabetes management strategies. It is critically important to ensure the uninterrupted availability of device supplies, particularly for users who depend on consistent and reliable data to make immediate and informed adjustments to their blood glucose levels.
